notes.title: A Sequel to Ultreïa is Coming!
notes.notes:
Experience a brief yet captivating chapter in Nymo's journey as you explore the mysterious desert of Ultreïa during the Night of the Eclipse. The game will be released this month, June 2024! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047600/Ultrea__Night_of_the_Eclipse/]Check Out the Steam Page[/url]

notes.title: Ultreïa is heading to Nintendo Switch! 🎮
notes.notes:
[b]This cute yet dark game will be released on Nintendo Switch this Friday, March 25, thanks to RedDeer.games.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37751847/f499ff61d4888a9212a40a5305cf0b238113534b.jpg[/img]

Watch the new trailer NOW: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JTMfDMJs5UQ

ABOUT REDDEER.GAMES
RedDeer.games is an award-winning global gaming company that focuses on developing and publishing unique indie games.

We aim to create accessible games, easily distinguishable by their original art style. Our main goal, however, is for them to be FUN!

In recent years we released Cyber Protocol, Clumsy Rush, Art Sqool, Nirvana Pilot Yume, Little Mouse’s Encyclopedia, Circa Infinity, Detective Di, Trash Quest, and AAA Clock.

notes.title: Update Note 12/01/2022
notes.notes:
- Title language bug fixed.
- Inventory locked bug fixed.

This update contains a PDF Art Book featuring doodles, cover researches and work in progress from 2020.

1. Open Steam and find Ultreïa in your Library games list.
2. Right-click on the game's icon, select Properties and click the Local Files tab.
3. Click the Browse Local Files... button.
4. Find the PDF file inside the "PDF Art Book" folder.
